learned.name: sky-handoff
learned.what: Luma reveal where the bright overcast sky of the outgoing shot dissolves first and the land goes last, so the place change happens in the clouds.
learned.when: Overcast or bright-sky footage where outgoing and incoming shots both have a large sky in the top third at a similar brightness; use as the only transition family, two times per video at most.

learned.name: rolling-dateline
learned.what: A light tabular clock that rolls from one filming time to the next (eased), followed by a hairline and a tracked caps place label. It marks a time and place jump with no sentence.
learned.when: One-day or journey videos with known capture times; place it on the first shot after the jump, in sky or dark negative space.

learned.name: type-in-dark-interior
learned.what: Set titles in a dark band the footage already has (train ceiling, window frame, tunnel wall) instead of over the view, so the type looks like part of the place.
learned.when: POV shots from vehicles or interiors with a dark frame around the window.

spec.note: check the contact sheet for the dark band's y-range in 9:16 and keep the text inside it

wishlist.why: needs per-frame subject segmentation (matting model on CPU)
Needs depth estimation per frame (a monocular depth model on CPU) to place volumetric haze behind the near trees and in front of the far ones.

wishlist.effect: per-mask grade split (warm only the red seats)
wishlist.why: Needs colour-key or segmentation masks per shot to grade one object separately from the rest of the frame.
